title: Routing Strategy Designer — Region & Tier Selector with Fallback Matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a user-facing Routing Strategy Designer in Console that lets customers declare region preferences, tiered routing (e.g., dedicated vs hosted), and explicit fallback model variants in a single, testable canvas. The feature should make routing rules discoverable, validate correctness before save, and provide deterministic previews for a set of sample traffic scenarios.

Background: Customers running multi-region and multi-tier deployments need a simple way to express preferences (region-first, lowest-latency, cost-aware) together with safety fallbacks (model variant downgraded for capacity or quota). Current Console panels are fragmented: region selectors, deployment settings, and model variant toggles live in separate screens which causes confusion and misconfigurations.

Scope:
- New Console surface: Routing Strategy Designer modal + persistent saved configuration.
- Three key controls: ordered region list with weights, tier preference selector (hosted -> dedicated -> private), and a fallback matrix where customers map primary model -> 1..3 fallback variants with conditions.
- Client-side validation rules and server-side verification that runs preflight checks against account capacity metadata.
- Scenario preview runner that synthesizes 10 deterministic requests and shows routing decisions + estimated latency/cost delta.

Out of scope for this ticket: automated policy simulation over live traffic, RBAC per-rule (will be a follow-up), and fine-grained bandwidth quotas.

User stories:
- As a platform engineer, I want to pin a primary model and provide two fallbacks so my app stays available during capacity constraints.
- As a PM, I want to preview how 95th-percentile latency changes under region failover so I can set SLAs.
- As an SRE, I want validation that prevents circular fallbacks or invalid region names before I save the policy.
acceptance_criteria: Designer UI lets users create an ordered region list and persist it to the routing config
Tier selector supports declarative ordering and per-tier percentage traffic split (0-100)
Fallback matrix allows mapping a primary model to up to 3 fallback variants with condition types: capacity, latency, error-rate
Save action runs client-side validation and then a server preflight check; blockers surfaced inline
Preview runner executes deterministic scenario set and shows routing decisions, estimated latency, and cost delta in a single table
Telemetry emits events for create/update/delete of strategies and preview runs; metrics appear on Console telemetry dashboard
telemetry: event: routing_strategy.preview.run (strategyId, scenarioSetId, decisions, estimatedLatencyMs, estimatedCostCents)
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal + 3 trusted customers behind feature flag (2 weeks)
Canary: enable for 10% of new console users and monitor errors and preview success rate (1 week)
GA: roll to 100% after zero-blocking validation and <1% config-related incidents over 2 weeks
notes: Trade-off: keep client-side validation strict to reduce bad configs vs allowing advanced freeform rules. Chosen: strict JSON linting + an advanced mode toggle.
Decision: preview runner uses synthesized deterministic traces (not live sampling) to keep customer data out of the flow and avoid PII concerns.
Dependency: requires ENG to expose account capacity and model-variant compatibility API (ENG-9482).
